stored_prefix_runtime_lane_add.precondition: In the stored-prefix reader, DATA is dead after adding into TOTAL and LEFT is scratch; the transform consumes DATA and uses LEFT lanes as traversal-marker/carry state.
stored_prefix_runtime_lane_add.postcondition: TOTAL=(old TOTAL+old DATA) mod 2^64; DATA=0; LEFT=0; ANS/BACK/MARKER unchanged.

interpretation: Two independent vertical slices now validate the same 10x design principle: retain a dense radix representation but encode fixed-width digit work as runtime moving loops rather than Python-unrolled source. Decimal output, previously the largest generic backend emitter, falls to about 10.5% of the Quad source in standalone comparison.
